 Summary 
 On October 21, 2026, the Node.js project released security updates addressing a critical vulnerability in the Brotli decoder bundled with Node.js, commonly referred to as "Node2Shell" (tracked as CVE-2026-111497). The vulnerability is an out-of-bounds write that could allow a remote attacker to cause memory corruption and potentially execute arbitrary code.
sections.impact:
The following versions of Siemens Desigo, Gridscale are affected:

 
 Desigo CC family V8 vers:all/* (CVE-2026-111497)

 Desigo CC family V9 vers:all/* (CVE-2026-111497)

 Gridscale X DSA vers:intdot/>=5.3|<5.4 (CVE-2026-111497)

 
 Gridscale X PSS®E vers:intdot/<36.8.0 (CVE-2026-111497)

 

 
 
 
 
 
 CVSS 
 Vendor 
 Equipment 
 
 
 
 
 v3 9.8 
 Siemens 
 Desigo CC family V8 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 1 Vulnerability 
 
 
 
 
 Out-of-bounds Write 
 
 
 
 
 Background 
 
 Critical Infrastructure Sectors: Critical Manufacturing, Energy, Information Technology

 Countries/Areas Deployed: Worldwide

 Company Headquarters Location: Germany

 
 
 Vulnerabilities 
 
 CVE-2026-111497 
 A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream. CISA reminds organizations to perform proper impact analysis and risk assessment prior to deploying defensive measures. This advisory covers the status of impact of various Siemens software products.

Assessed severity: LOW. CVSS score: 3.1/10.
sections.mitigation:
As a general security measure Siemens strongly recommends to protect network access with appropriate mechanisms (e.g. firewalls, segmentation, VPN). Additional mitigation guidance and recommended practices are publicly available on the ICS webpage at cisa.gov/ics in the technical information paper, ICS-TIP-12-146-01B--Targeted Cyber Intrusion Detection and Mitigation Strategies . Siemens has released new versions for the affected products and recommends to update to the latest versions. Read More 
 
 4 Affected Products 
 
 Desigo CC family V8 
 
 Product Status: known_affected, known_not_affected

 
 Remediations 
 
 Vendor fix 
Install the latest .NET security updates via Windows Update.
